title: Finite etale local factors lift from formal monoid coefficients
statement: Let $(E,\mathfrak n)$ be a nonzero complete regular Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], let $S$ be a fine saturated monoid [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] which is sharp, meaning that $0$ is its only invertible element, and put $H=E[[S]]$, the completion at $(\mathfrak n,[s]:s\ne0)$ of the monoid ring $E[S]$, which has $E$-basis $[s]$ ($s\in S$) and multiplication $[s][s']=[s+s']$. Let $f$ belong to the maximal ideal of $H$, allowing $f=0$, and put $A_0=H/(f)$. Let $K$ be a nonzero local finite etale $A_0$-algebra; finite etale means finite as a module and etale on affine spectra [def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then there exist a nonzero complete regular Noetherian local finite etale $E$-algebra $D$ with residue field $\kappa(K)$ and a continuous $A_0$-algebra isomorphism $K\cong D[[S]]/(f)$, where $f$ on the right is its coefficientwise image. Moreover $\mathfrak m_D=\mathfrak nD$, and the image in $D$ of every element of $\mathfrak n\setminus\mathfrak n^2$ lies in $\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$. A local ring has a unique maximal ideal; complete means that its canonical map to its maximal-ideal completion is an isomorphism. Here $D[[S]]$ is defined by the same combined-adic monoid-ring completion as $E[[S]]$, and $\kappa(K)$ is the quotient of $K$ by its unique maximal ideal.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-finite-etale-formal-monoid-coefficient-lift] to the given $E,S,f,K$. Its hypotheses are exactly those here: $E$ is nonzero complete regular Noetherian local, $S$ is fine saturated and sharp, $H$ is the combined-adic completion of $E[S]$, $f$ lies in its maximal ideal (zero is allowed), and $K$ is nonzero local finite etale over $H/(f)$. Its conclusion gives the same finite etale coefficient algebra $D$, its completeness and regularity, its residue field $\kappa(K)$, the continuous $A_0$-algebra isomorphism $K\cong D[[S]]/(f)$ with coefficientwise image of $f$, the equality $\mathfrak m_D=\mathfrak nD$, and preservation of every class from $\mathfrak n\setminus\mathfrak n^2$. The final sentences of the present statement only spell out local rings, completion, and the residue field; they impose no extra hypothesis or conclusion. Thus all clauses follow by direct specialization, with no auxiliary construction.
